parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-16 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 312.0 | 6.08 | 6.08
2 | 794.3 | 14.76 | 20.84
3 | 884.4 | 3.48 | 24.32
4 | 1280.2 | 10.95 | 35.27
5 | 4929.0 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-16
Curve type: A-type (continuously ascending resistivity: ρ1<ρ2<ρ3<ρ4<ρ5)
Aquifer depth: 24.32 – 35.27 m (Layer 4, fractured/weathered basement zone)

Recommendation: Target drilling through Layer 4 (24.3–35.3 m), which likely represents a fractured/weathered basement zone capable of water storage. Terminate drilling at or just below 35 m, as the sharp resistivity increase to 4929 ohm-m marks competent, unweathered basement with negligible water-bearing potential.
